profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Building agentic AI solutions to supercharge sales teams to be more productive and efficient with their time so they can work on the highest value-add tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Reimagining Meta's internal CRM product from the ground up with agentic AI solutions as first-class features.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Improving the reliability and experience of Dandy's DDC UI and web services, which helps manage our workforce of dental product designers to ship high-quality designs for dental fabrications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built an API gateway to orchestrate communications between a fleet of robots and cloud services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building privacy tooling in the Connectivity Analytics team at Meta, who helps improve cellular network conditions around the world with data aggregation soultions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the events experience for Meta's Horizon, a virtual reality social product. Focusing on retention and growth of Horizon users, and helping them engage in rich, interactive social experiences to create a sense of community in the metaverse.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building out tools on Facebook’s emotional health hub to help de-stigmatize issues around and provide resources for improving mental health and wellbeing. Took a product from 0->1 to encourage users to express Gratitude that has been found to provide a lift of 3% of grateful feelings towards users' friends, and serves 100k users per week.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Managed a team of 4 engineers building a tool that simplified that automated and human review decision-making for all reviewable entities across Facebook's ecosystem, and helped drive down tier 0 support ticket times, as well as providing transparency for engineering and operational users debugging review system issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built out internal tools for our ad review platform, including optimizing human reviewer efficiency by improving the UI used to review ads, migrating the account actioning framework to a new platform with improved logging and auditing features, and creating a product 0->1 that simplified the review lifecycle all reviewable entities in Facebook's ecosystem to a human readable timeline and signal aggregation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineering team lead creating cutting edge open source features for E-Commerce solutions, including building an extensible and modular GraphQL layer over the open source platform so customers could more easily integrate the platform into their online shops.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created open source, extensible modules for the enterprise E-Commerce platform Magento.

positions.title: System Developer Sr. Analyst
positions.description: Texas Medicaid and Healthcare Partnership project
